title: Business Analyst Intern
description:
At Consilium Safety Group, we don’t just make technology, we create solutions that protect people, values, and the planet. As a global leader in fire and gas safety technology, we serve critical industries such as marine, energy, rolling stock, and critical infrastructure.


With more than 100 years of expertise, we combine deep industry knowledge with cutting\-edge innovation to shape the future of Safety Tech. We are headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden, with over 55 offices worldwide.


We are a fast\-evolving global organization backed by the private equity firm Antin Infrastructure Partners and are continuing an ambitious journey of expansion and transformation. With strong financial support and a clear strategic vision, we are investing in innovation, operational excellence, and talent — the key drivers that will take us to the next level.


This is truly an exciting time to join us!


As part of our digital transformation journey, we are strengthening our capabilities within Data Foundation and Master Data Management (MDM) to improve data quality, streamline business processes, and enable better decision\-making across the organization.


We are looking for a proactive, analytical, and detail\-oriented Business Analyst Intern who is curious about how businesses operate and interested in process improvement, data governance, and operational excellence.


In this role, you will work closely with business stakeholders, data owners, and technical teams to understand how processes work today, identify opportunities for improvement, and help shape how they should work in the future.


This is an opportunity to gain hands\-on experience in business process analysis, data management, and digital transformation while working with colleagues across different functions.

**Your role**


As a Business Analyst Intern, you will support initiatives related to business process analysis and Master Data Management. You will help the team understand and document existing processes, identify improvement opportunities, and contribute to initiatives that improve data quality and operational efficiency.


Your responsibilities will include:

* Supporting the preparation of data quality insights, status reports, management presentations, and governance documentation.
* Developing and maintaining As\-Is and To\-Be process models, including master data lifecycle activities, roles, controls, approval flows, and system interactions.
* Analyzing business processes and operational metrics to identify opportunities to simplify workflows and improve efficiency.
* Creating and maintaining process maps, workflow diagrams, and operating procedures for key business functions.
* Supporting and, where appropriate, facilitating process discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, and walkthrough sessions.
* Documenting end\-to\-end processes, including responsibilities, dependencies, handoffs, and interactions between business and technical teams.
* Contributing to broader data quality, Master Data Management, and process improvement initiatives.

**What we're looking for**


We are looking for someone who is curious, structured, and eager to learn. You don't need to have extensive professional experience — we value your analytical mindset, willingness to take initiative, and interest in understanding how businesses and processes work.


You are likely:

* Currently pursuing, or recently graduated from, a degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Supply Chain Management, Management, or a related field.
* Interested in business process mapping, process improvement, operations, and data management.
* A strong analytical and structured thinker with great attention to detail.
* Comfortable working with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and other business productivity tools.
* A clear communicator who can collaborate effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.
* Able to organize and manage multiple tasks while also working independently when needed.
* Curious and comfortable asking questions, challenging existing ways of working, and learning from others.

**What you can expect**


This internship will give you the opportunity to gain practical experience in a global digital transformation environment, working at the intersection of business processes, data, and technology.


You will have the opportunity to:

* Work with experienced professionals across business, data, and technology.
* Gain hands\-on experience in Business Analysis and Master Data Management.
* Develop practical skills in process mapping, stakeholder management, data quality, and process improvement.
* Contribute to initiatives with a real impact on how the organization operates and makes decisions.

**Ready to Make a Difference?**


If you're a hands\-on technician who enjoys solving technical challenges, working with customers, and travelling to different vessels and locations, we'd love to hear from you.

**Apply today!** We review applications continuously.


Join **Consilium Safety Group** and become part of our mission to protect lives through innovative safety technology.

title: Data Analyst
description:
**Data Analyst**

We are seeking a highly skilled **Data Analyst** with **2 years of experience** in building and maintaining **ETL/ELT pipelines**, working with diverse data sources, developing **Power BI reports**, and ensuring high\-quality, reliable data across the organization.  
The ideal candidate should have strong **analytical skills**, excellent knowledge of **numbers and business context**, and hands\-on experience in **data cleaning, transformation, modeling, and optimization**.

**Key Responsibilities1\. ETL/ELT \& Data Pipelines**

* Design, develop, and maintain **ETL/ELT pipelines** for structured and unstructured data.
* Work with tools such as **Power Query, SQL\-based ETL, Dataflows, ADF, SSIS, or similar platforms**.
* Automate data ingestion, transformation, and integration workflows.
* Troubleshoot pipeline failures and optimize performance.

**2\. Data Management \& Databases**

* Work with multiple databases such as **SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Azure SQL, Oracle, or cloud\-based DBs**.
* Write optimized **SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and functions**.
* Perform data extraction, cleaning, profiling, and validation at scale.

**3\. Data Cleaning, Transformation \& Quality**

* Handle large volumes of raw data and transform them into clean, usable datasets.
* Create data validation checks and ensure **accuracy, consistency, and completeness** across systems.
* Apply data optimization techniques to improve refresh times and model performance.

**4\. Business Intelligence \& Reporting**

* Develop and maintain **Power BI dashboards, reports, and datasets**.
* Use **Power Query** and **DAX** to create calculated columns, measures, and date intelligence logic.
* Publish and manage reports in **Power BI Service**, including refresh schedules, Row\-Level Security (RLS), and workspaces.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements and deliver insights.

**5\. Automation \& Productivity Tools**

* Build automation using tools like **Power Automate, Python scripts, Excel VBA, or workflow tools**.
* Implement scheduled tasks to streamline repetitive processes.
* Integrate BI outputs with email alerts, SharePoint, Teams, and other systems.

**6\. Excel \& Analytical Skills**

* Strong command of **Excel**: Power Query, PivotTables, advanced formulas, and data modeling.
* Excellent ability to work with numbers, perform analysis, detect patterns, and identify anomalies.

**7\. Domain \& Business Understanding**

* Interpret data with a strong understanding of **business KPIs, metrics, and operational logic**.
* Provide insights that support decision\-making across departments.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* **2 years** of hands\-on experience as a Data Analyst or similar role.
* Solid experience building **ETL/ELT pipelines** and integrating diverse data sources.
* Strong SQL skills for data extraction, transformation, and performance tuning.
* Experience with **Power BI, Power BI Service**, and **Power Query**.
* Experience working with files, APIs, databases, cloud storage, SharePoint, Excel, CSV, JSON, etc.
* Strong data modeling and DAX knowledge.
* Proficiency with **Excel** (advanced).
* Experience with **automation tools** (Power Automate, scripting, or similar).
* Strong analytical thinking and numerical ability.
* Knowledge of **data validation, data governance, and data quality frameworks**.

**Good to Have (Optional)**

* Experience with **Azure Data Factory, Dataflows, Databricks, or cloud data integration tools**.
* Knowledge of Python or R for data manipulation.
* Experience working in Agile environments.
* Understanding of **version control** (Git) and CI/CD for analytics.

title: Business Intelligence Associate
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and detail\-oriented Business Intelligence Associate to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for analyzing business processes, identifying areas for improvement, and recommending solutions to drive operational efficiency and effectiveness. You will collaborate closely with stakeholders, including management, operations, and IT teams, to gather requirements, define business needs, and ensure successful implementation of solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

* **Data Analysis and Reporting:** Collect, analyze, and interpret large datasets from various sources to identify trends, patterns, and business opportunities.
* **Dashboard Development:** Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Excel, VBA, etc.).
* **Data Integration:** Integrate data from multiple sources, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and timeliness for reporting and analysis.
* **Business Insights:** Provide actionable insights and recommendations based on data analysis to support decision\-making processes across departments.
* **Data Quality Management:** Monitor and ensure data integrity, cleanliness, and consistency across various systems and reports.
* **Trend Analysis:** Identify and track key business metrics, industry trends, and competitor benchmarks to support strategic initiatives.

title: Business Immigration Analyst
description:
**Job Description**

**About the Role:** Fragomen’s Business Immigration Analyst position will provide you with the opportunity to make an immediate impact on our business, as well as offering training, development, and long\-term growth opportunities. Fragomen’s exclusive focus on immigration means you will work in an exciting, dynamic, and challenging atmosphere with people who are passionate about immigration. Providing world class client service and industry leading technology solutions, Fragomen helps our clients to navigate the complex world of global immigration to better achieve their goals.


**How will you make a difference as a Business Immigration Analyst at Fragomen?**

* Learn about the various types of immigration matters and build knowledge of firm, immigration case types and client processes.
* Perform tasks related to case preparation and filing of petitions with government agencies, including document gathering, document review, case drafting, and case filing.
* With the guidance of your supervisor, communicate with foreign nationals and client contacts, providing clear and prompt responses regarding case status or other general inquiries.
* Meet assigned deadlines that adhere to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and communicate case progress, status, escalations to supervisor.
* Compile and summarize large quantities of data within case management systems for reporting to clients, managers and team.
* Understand and contribute to team and individual productivity goals.
* Demonstrate flexibility and initiative.
* Follow documented firm standards and policies to mitigate risk and ensure regulatory, operational and client compliance (e.g., following Data Privacy protocols, using Connect accurately and in line with team and client protocols, etc.).

**Leverage your valuable skills and experience to make an impact at Fragomen:**

* Bachelor’s degree, Associate’s degree, Paralegal certification OR experience in a customer facing or client service\-oriented role
* A client\-service mindset, attention to details and ability to work in a fast\-paced environment with competing demands
* The ability to prioritize, meet deadlines and escalate case issues to supervisor
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to proofread documents, draft fluent prose, and avoid grammatical mistakes without the aid of AI engines
* Experience using various computer systems, including MS Word and Excel
* Desire to contribute to positive work environment, effectively collaborate and promote teamwork

**Benefits:**

At Fragomen, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits which includes:


* 22 PTO days \+ Federal holidays
* Medical, Dental, and Vision plans \+ FSA \& HSA Plans
* 401K plan, with company matching

**Learn More About Fragomen:**

Please take time to read *About Us* , explore the *Meaningful and Impactful Work* we do for our clients, and review the standard *Benefits* we offer. You can find all the material to the right of this page.
